response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership in open-source and workshop initiatives, but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience and mobile platform expertise, which are key for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership through open-source projects and workshops
Broad technical stack spanning mobile, web, and systems programming with strong testing focus
concerns: No clear documentation of formal people management or team leadership responsibilities
Limited evidence of mobile platform ecosystem experience despite iOS app maintenance
No mention of roadmap planning, organizational change, or cross-team alignment initiatives
